WITH telescope_counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
shares AS (
  SELECT telescope_count,
         CAST(telescope_count AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share
  FROM telescope_counts
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT telescope_count, share,
         share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares) AS excess_share
  FROM shares
  WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)
)
SELECT AVG(telescope_count) AS average_telescope_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(excess_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average;
